subject.title: fix(sessions): keep Matrix DM session keys case-distinct per peer

question: What compatibility contract should govern existing `session.identityLinks` canonical labels beginning with `@` now that Matrix native IDs need distinct provenance?
rationale: The current schema turns a previously valid user configuration into a startup/config-validation failure. Choosing whether to retain those labels or retire them through a migration defines a durable configuration and session-continuity contract that cannot be safely inferred from this PR alone.

options.title: Preserve existing labels until a compatible representation exists
options.body: Keep `@`-prefixed canonical labels valid and introduce an explicit linked-identity provenance representation before enforcing a restriction.

options.title: Deprecate labels through Doctor migration
options.body: Retain the restriction only with a tested `openclaw doctor --fix` migration that rewrites affected config and preserves or deliberately migrates linked session continuity.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing labels until a compatible representation exists
recommendation.body: Keep `@`-prefixed canonical labels valid and introduce an explicit linked-identity provenance representation before enforcing a restriction.

likelyOwner.reason: They identified the final provenance ambiguity and are already reviewing the exact construction, alias-proof, and upgrade boundary.
